name: Notes Card
description: A task list app screen, drawn inside a phone: a card that fills the display and carries its own tab bar, so the navigation belongs to the thing it navigates rather than floating beside it. Built on a design system stated once: two type sizes, two weights, and three concentric radii where a child's corner is its parent's minus the padding between them. Rows are wells recessed into the card with a 1px inset ring rather than a border, so they read as cut into the surface instead of drawn on it. The leading mark is a ring filled as a wedge in proportion to subtasks done — drawn on the icon set's own 24 grid at the same stroke weight, so it shares a column with every other glyph. Status pills use `text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic` to centre on their cap height rather than their line box, avatars ring themselves in the row's fill through a custom property so the bite stays clean on hover, and every left edge is a sum of paddings that lands on one 16px column. Colour is OKLCH throughout at hue 264, with the ink value spent in exactly two places — the primary action and the selected tab. Renders entirely on the server.

variations.name: default
variations.description: A task list screen inside a phone shell — status bar, home indicator, and a card that fills the display between them. Header with a primary action, a segmented filter, and date-grouped rows carrying completion, status, counts and collaborator faces. Two type sizes, two weights, three concentric radii, and one 16px column every left edge resolves to. The progress mark is a wedge drawn on the icon set's own grid, the last row sits mid-swipe with its delete action revealed, and the whole thing is OKLCH at a single hue. Static — no hooks, no motion, zero JavaScript.

props.name: time
props.description: Clock in the status bar. Defaults to "9:41". Set in tabular figures so a different time cannot shift the radios beside it.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the scaling root. The device is fixed at a 390 × 844 screen inside a 12px bezel and is scaled to the caller's width by a viewBox, so it shrinks to fit a narrow column and stops at its natural 414px — set a `max-w-*` here to cap it smaller.
